caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with armrests, positioned at a slight angle facing right and occupying the center of a plain, light beige background. The chair is made of polished brown wood, featuring curved legs, ornate armrests, and a decorative, shaped backrest with a central splat. The seat cushion is upholstered in a dark, almost black fabric, decorated with a floral pattern in shades of pink, purple, green, and yellow. The drawing is carefully detailed, showing the wood grain and joints of the chair construction. There are minor marks or spots visible on the background near the top of the backrest. The entire composition is framed by a fine rectangular border close to the edges of the image.
title: Chair (Host)
